source.reference: Scenario assumption: a 100 m 1000BASE-T path using Belden 2412; 100 m is this example's upper design bound, not a measured installation length or a universal PHY cutoff. IEEE 1000BASE-T 100 m channel context: https://www.ieee802.org/3/10GBT/public/material/diminico_IWCS.PDF . Belden nominal propagation velocity is 70% of vacuum c, while its listed maximum delay at 100 MHz is 537.6 ns/100 m: https://catalog.belden.com/techdata/EN/2412_techdata.pdf . Vacuum c=299792458 m/s: https://www.nist.gov/si-redefinition/definitions-si-base-units . The 1000 Mb/s cap follows the cited endpoint port limits.
